S50Z26.today_summary: 1,067.2 is a +13.5-point (+1.28%) close and the window high, lifting spot 17.2 points above a max pain welded at 1,050 for eight straight sessions - triple the widest gap of the prior four (+5.4 on 10-20). 10.78% ATM IV is the window low, down -1.03 from 11.81%, cutting the 1-sigma day to 7.25 points. 1.21 pc_vol on 2,151 put lots against 1,778 call lots reads bearish until the OI prints land: put OI -102, call OI +524, so that put volume was closing, not opening. The 1,100 call wall now sits 32.8 points away - 4.5 one-sigma days, but only 0.57 of the 57.5-point one-sigma move left to 29 December.
what_changed: Board-wide net GEX flipped positive, -113.0 to +2,986.8, and the cumulative gamma flip came back inside the ladder at 1,100 after four sessions with no crossing at all.
Put OI fell for the first time in the window, -102 to 11,626, led by -133 at 1,020 on 211 lots and -91 at 1,050 on 319 lots, while call OI added +524 to 11,420 - pc_oi 1.076 to 1.018.
25d skew deepened call-rich to -1.94 from -0.85, and the delta bands shifted up a full strike: put_25d 1,010 to 1,030, call_25d 1,080 to 1,090, call_10d 1,110 to 1,120.
ATM IV round-tripped to the window low at 10.78% from 11.81%, a -1.03-point compression on a +13.5-point up day - the opposite of the max-pain-failure signature.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: Across 10-20 to 10-27 spot travelled 1,055.4 - 1,043.1 - 1,044.6 - 1,053.7 - 1,067.2, a net +11.8, while max pain never moved off 1,050 and neither wall migrated: 1,100 calls and 960 puts have held for all eight sessions on the board. The real cross-day event is the gamma repair - board net GEX ran -1,653.1 (10-21), -1,338.4 (10-22), -113.0 (10-23), +2,986.8 (today), a 4,640-point swing that converted a book short gamma at every listed strike into one with a working long-gamma shelf and an in-ladder flip at 1,100. Total OI 23,046 is +3,951 (+20.7%) over the five sessions, but today's +422 is a near-stall against +3,958 across the prior four, and the composition inverted: the 20.2% put build that drove the Protection read reversed -102 in a single session. IV ended where it started the window, 10.73% to 10.78%, having spiked to 12.17% on the 10-21 selloff and given it all back - the rally was bought without paying up for vol. The five-day structure therefore reads as a completed hedge-unwind into strength: the downside insurance that was accumulated through 10-22 is being lifted at higher prices, which removes the cushion that absorbed the 10-21 break as much as it confirms the bid.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1020P / 1000P x 1100C / 1120C
strategies.rationale: The matrix answer for long gamma + compressed IV: both short strikes sit on the two live walls bounding the +4,171.9 shelf - the 1,100 call wall (1,670 OI, 278 lots) and the 1,020 near put wall (978 OI) - so dealer hedging inside 1,020-1,100 works for the position rather than against it.
strategies.defined_risk: Net credit approx 4.9 points (sell 1,020P 6.7 + 1,100C 6.7, buy 1,000P 4.9 + 1,120C 3.6); max loss = 20-point wing - 4.9 = 15.1 points per side, 3,020 baht at 200/point. Short vol is negative-skew - size small.

S50Z26.prediction: Base case is 1,050-1,100 containment: the +4,171.9 near-money shelf dampens inside that corridor, 10.78% IV prices only a 7.25-point day, and the 1,100 wall is 4.5 one-sigma days away with 1,670 live contracts on it. The asymmetry is below - a close under 1,040 crosses the per-strike flip into -945.4 at 1,020 and -967.5 at 1,000 with the put cushion thinner than it was a session ago, so a downside break should be treated as accelerating rather than fading. Spot 17.2 points above a static 1,050 max pain is the max-pain-failure watch item, but IV compressing -1.03 on the move is the opposite of the confirming signature, so the fade-toward-1,050 read survives for now.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no instruction to execute anything. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1,050 max pain and the 1,100 cap as tendencies, not guarantees. At 63 DTE peak gamma is only 0.0079, so the shelf dampens rather than pins, and macro or news flow can override the option structure outright. Defined risk is not risk-free - the capped max loss on every structure above is real and does occur.
